name: Slider
statusNote: Expressive adds the centered and vertical configurations, handle narrowing while interacting, a gap between track and handle, and inset icons. The continuous, range and stepped value model is unchanged. MDC-Android renamed continuous to standard and discrete to stops.
summary: A one-dimensional control for selecting a value, or a range with two handles, from a continuous or stepped scale. Choose it over a stepper or text input when relative position matters more than the exact number.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The current value, within valueRange. For a range slider, the start of the selected range.

inputs.name: valueEnd
inputs.description: The end of the selected range. Supplying it makes the slider a range slider with two handles.

inputs.name: onValueChange
inputs.description: Called with the new value (or range) on every change during drag, tap or key press.

inputs.name: onValueChangeFinished
inputs.description: Called once when the user finishes a change, e.g. on drag release.

inputs.name: valueRange
inputs.description: The [min, max] pair of the scale. Compose defaults to 0..1.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of discrete stops between the two ends. 0 makes the slider continuous.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Enables interaction; disabled sliders use the disabled-* tokens.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Horizontal is Slider/RangeSlider; vertical is VerticalSlider, which Compose offers for single-value sliders only.

inputs.name: topToBottom
inputs.description: Vertical only: whether the minimum is at the top.

inputs.name: track
inputs.description: Standard fills from the track's start; centered fills from the midpoint toward the handle. Compose selects this by passing SliderDefaults.CenteredTrack as the track slot.

inputs.name: startIcon
inputs.description: Inset icon drawn inside the track at the start end. Standard slider only; not in Compose.

inputs.name: endIcon
inputs.description: Inset icon drawn inside the track at the end. Standard slider only; not in Compose.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible label. On a range slider, give each handle its own, e.g. "start" and "end".

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: An inactive (unfilled) segment and an active (filled) segment, stadium-capped by default.

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.description: A narrow filled bar with fully rounded ends, perpendicular to the track.

anatomy.name: Track gap
anatomy.description: A visible break in the track on either side of each handle.

anatomy.name: Stop indicator
anatomy.description: A small dot marking a discrete step position, and the end of the track.

anatomy.name: Value indicator
anatomy.description: A label popup above the handle showing the numeric value. Specified by tokens and MDC; not implemented in the pinned Compose source.

anatomy.name: Inset icon
anatomy.description: An icon drawn inside the track at one or both ends. Standard slider only.

variants.description: The value fills from the track's leading edge.
The range straddles a midpoint, e.g. -100..100 defaulting to 0; the fill grows from the centre in either direction. Same tokens, different geometry.
Two handles select a min/max pair. Sizing tokens are shared; there is no per-handle colour split.
Dimension tokens are orientation-agnostic; width and height swap.
Snaps to ticks; the stop-indicator-* tokens apply only here. MDC calls this stops; Compose calls it discrete.

layout.text: Narrow the handle to exactly half its full width while it is focused, pressed or dragged. Compute it as handle-width / 2 at draw time; do not read pressed-handle-width or focus-handle-width, though the result coincides with them.
Hover alone does not narrow the handle; hover-handle-width stays at full width.
Each gap measures from the handle's centre: half the handle's current thickness plus active-handle-leading-space. The gap therefore widens as the handle narrows; it is not a fixed length.
Draw the inside corner of a track segment that meets a gap at a hard-coded 2dp, whatever active-track-shape-leading says.
Round the outer track corners, and any segment side away from a gap, to a full stadium: radius is half the track's measured cross-axis thickness, not a fixed token value.
On a centered slider, draw the active segment from the track's midpoint to the handle, and apply the gap and inside-corner treatment at the midpoint end as well as at the handle.
On a range slider, size each handle's gap from that handle's own current width. The two gaps are independent and differ while only one handle is narrowed.
When vertical, swap width and height for every dimension token: track thickness is the fixed axis and length the flexible one. The handle becomes handle-height wide and handle-width tall.
When vertical and topToBottom is false, mirror the drawing with a scale(1, -1) transform instead of recomputing coordinates.
Place stop indicators at steps + 2 evenly spaced fractions of the track, including both ends.
Skip any stop indicator that falls inside a handle's gap, and any that coincides with the end-of-track stop indicator already drawn, so stops never render under or beside a handle.
Size the track's end stop indicator and every tick with stop-indicator-size, drawn as a circle.
Draw an inset icon inside the track's own thickness. Neither Compose nor the tokens give its size or inset; MDC names the size trackIconSize without a default, so choose one deliberately.
Place the value indicator above the handle, separated by value-indicator-active-bottom-space.

states.text: Colour the handle handle-color, the active segment active-track-color and the inactive segment inactive-track-color.
Colour ticks with the opposite segment's colour: ticks on the active segment take inactive-track-color, ticks on the inactive segment take active-track-color.
Narrow the handle to half width and show a focus ring shaped by handle-shape. Press gives no ripple.
Narrow the handle to half width and widen both gaps to match.
Narrow the handle exactly as when pressed; drag and press share one active state.
Apply each disabled colour at its disabled opacity; composite the handle over the surface colour. Snap immediately, without animation.

behaviour.text: While dragging a stepped slider, snap the pointer position to the nearest tick on every move, with no dead zone; the handle jumps tick to tick during the drag, not only on release.
Drive handle narrowing and gap widening from one signal, focused or pressed or dragged, so the handle edge and gap edge never mismatch.
The pinned source changes handle width and gap instantly. Animate them deliberately, e.g. with fast-spatial, rather than copying the omission.
Each arrow key moves the value by one delta: range / (steps + 1) when stepped, range / 100 when continuous.
Page Up and Page Down move by page × delta, where page = (steps + 1) / 10, or 100 / 10 when continuous, clamped to 1..10. Every key move clamps to the value range.
Home and End jump to the minimum and maximum.
Keep range handles from crossing by coercion only; Compose has no minimum separation. Add one deliberately if the product needs MDC's minSeparation.

Show the value indicator only while the handle is touched or dragged by default (MDC labelBehavior floating); allow forcing it always visible or always hidden. Build it as a tooltip-style popup from the value-indicator-* tokens.

keyboard: Right and Up arrow increase the value by one step; Left and Down decrease it. In RTL, Left and Right are reversed.
Page Up and Page Down move by a larger multi-step increment.
Home and End jump to the minimum and maximum.
On a range slider, Tab moves between the two handles.
semantics: Expose the current value, minimum, maximum and step, and announce the formatted value live as it changes.
Enforce a 48dp touch target around the handle, independent of its 4dp-class visual width.
On a range slider, expose each handle as a separate node with its own label so start and end are distinguishable.

notes.text: The 2dp inside corner at a gap is hard-coded; no token carries it.
active-track-shape-leading resolves to a full round, but Compose never uses it for the gap-facing corner. Use it, if at all, only for the outer corner.

Compose reads no per-state width or colour token: pressed-handle-width, focus-handle-width, hover-handle-width, disabled-handle-width and the pressed-, focus- and hover- colour tokens are unread. Narrowing is computed as half of handle-width.
Compose colours ticks from the track colours, so the stop-indicator colour tokens are unread.

The value indicator is ahead of Compose: no Slider.kt code path exists. MDC's TooltipDrawable behaviour (shape, floating placement above the handle, show on touch) is the spec of record, sized and coloured from the value-indicator-* tokens.
Inset icons have no Compose parameter or token; the only Compose precedent is a custom-track sample.
Ticks on the active segment take the inactive track colour and vice versa; do not colour ticks with their own segment's colour.
stop-indicator-shape is never read: drawStopIndicator always draws a hard-coded circle (drawCircle), sized from stop-indicator-size alone, with no shape lookup.
